tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// gter kha gong 'og gi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs mdor bsdus gsung rgyun ma bzhugs so// hūm̐/ o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams// padma ge sar sdong po la// ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes// padma 'byung gnas zhes su grags// 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor// khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyi// byin gyis rlob phyir gshegs su gsol// gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che// bdag gi spyi bor padma'i gdan bzhugs nas// bka' drin chen po'i sgo nas rjes bzung ste// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// e ma hoḥ spros bral chos kyi dbyings kyi zhing khams su// chos nyid dus gsum skye 'gag med pa'i ngang*// bya bral lhun rdzogs bde ba chen po'i sku// nam mkha' bzhin du thugs rje phyogs ris med// bla ma chos kyi sku la gsol ba 'debs// o rgyan padma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs// bde chen lhun gyis grub pa'i zhing khams su// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi// ye shes lnga ldan bde bar gshegs pa'i sku// thugs rje'i bye brag sna tshogs so sor ston// bla ma longs spyod rdzogs sku la gsol ba 'debs// o rgyan padma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs// mi mjed 'jig rten dag pa'i zhing khams su// thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba'i don la byon// gang la gang 'dul thabs kyis 'gro don mdzad// 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi// bla ma sprul ba'i sku la gsol ba 'debs// o rgyan padma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs// kun bzang rdor sems dga' rab shrī siṃ ha// padma ka ra rje 'bangs nyi shu lnga// so zur gnubs dang gter ston rgya mtsho sogs// bka' gter bla ma rnams la gsol= /mnga' skyong khri lde srin sbar gnas sogs kyi// zab gter sgo 'byed don du bstan pa'i bdag

/nyang rigs sku bltams ral pa'i cod pan can// gong ma nyi ma 'od zer la gsol= /de 'og zhing der spang ston grub pa'i sras// bod yul gter gcig gnam skas mkhar chu sogs// bco brgyad sgo 'byed gu ru chos dbang zhes// 'brel tshad don ldan chen po la gsol= /'gro ba'i mgon po padma dbang chen dang*// myos ston zhig po mi bskyod rdo rje sogs// sras dang slob ma rim par byon pa yi// brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang du// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid// rang sems chos sku mngon du ston mdzad pa'i// rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// bla ma sku khams bzang bar gsol ba 'debs// mchog tu sku tshe ring bar gsol ba 'debs// phrin las dar zhing rgyas par gsol ba 'debs// bla ma dang 'bral ba med par gyin gyis rlobs// skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang*// 'bral med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod de// sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas// rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog /khyed rnams bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// bdag sogs gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs su// nad gdon dbul phongs 'thab rtsod zhi ba dang*// chos dang bkra shis 'phel bar mdzad du gsol// ces pa gter kha gong 'og gi brgyud 'debs mdor bsdus rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i gsung rgyun las byung ba ltar bris pa dge/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
